lines.text: Astra: rest your finger while dragging the seek bar and a picture of that place appears. Playback has the switch.
Films whose Dolby or DTS sound Astra converts start as fast as the rest, and keep their surround for headphones.
Dolby Vision films that showed purple and green get their colours corrected. HDR works on every kind of stream.
More old files play: H.264 in AVI, H.263 in 3GP, and Windows Media sound in MKV.
